Game Overview

In Counter Craft 4, the core idea is straightforward: survive relentless waves of blocky zombies in Counter Craft 4. With strategic weapon upgrades and intuitive controls, navigate vibrant, ever-challenging landscapes. Master the art of destruction as each round promises more adrenaline and innovative ways to obliterate foes. Can you outsmart the relentless horde?
